questions.question: what did Zali Steggall reckon about the Climate Change (National Framework for Adaptation and Mitigation) (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2021

expected.answer: Zali Steggall spoke on the Climate Change (National Framework for Adaptation and Mitigation) (Consequential and Transitional Provisions) Bill 2021 on 18 October 2021 (speech-413018). The bill introduces mandatory climate risk disclosure for Commonwealth entities and establishes a Climate Change Commission to provide independent expert advice, replacing the Climate Change Authority. The speaker argued that the public sector is lagging behind private companies in reporting climate risks, citing legal precedents, international government actions, and the risk of higher lending costs and investment avoidance for Australia.
